provenance: Edition 2.0, reviewed 7 October 2026 at source revision 15b3a95. The primary daily workflow is physical 3.1.3 / 7E18. Retained 1.1.4 results keep separate records and profile limits. Working means observed within the named physical trial; owner acceptance is stated explicitly. Partial retains a material gate. Scores are editorial judgments, not measurements.

scale.functionality: How complete the behaviour is for someone using the device.
scale.implementation: How robust and general the underlying implementation is.

statuses.Working: Observed working on the physical device.

systems.reach: Boots to SpringBoard and an interactive home screen. Settings changes persist across a clean reboot. These historical hand checks do not qualify every newer SD-free profile combination.

The separate M68AP profile reaches its home screen with accepted touch, live Camera preview and saved VGA photos that reopen after a fresh boot. The PinePhone has an EG25-G modem; native telephony integration remains unaccepted. The later 3.1.3 profile has separate acceptance; 4A102 camera rail admission remains independently scoped.

Primary daily profile: owner-accepted touch, battery indication, stock Camera/Photos, complete power-off and reopening a new photograph after cold power-on. Ordinary restart, USB pairing and rotation remain separate pending gates.

features.note: The 7E18 daily hand test accepts unlock and touch after native boot. Retained N45/M68 4A102 results remain separate.
3.1.3 / 7E18 reaches its interactive home screen on the phone; the older M68 1.1.4 result remains E32.
A newly captured 7E18 photo reopens after full Power-slider halt and cold power-on. Fresh root/data copies pass fsck; sudden-power-loss durability remains unproven.

SD-free RTC/watchdog recovery passes a deliberate early pre-XNU stall; Jumpdrive returns without further serial commands. This is not arbitrary-hang coverage, and normal daily boot/runtime watchdogs remain off.
Accepted daily 7E18 uses the shared exact-build adapter family. Binding inspection is E41; shared source does not imply equal ABIs.
Twelve-second default route; separately accepted back-buffer rendering and Volume/Power selection. Later styling is a separate candidate.
Tow-Boot from eMMC hardware boot area reaches the selector and Jumpdrive with SD absent; the bootloader is preserved.
The physical 7E18 hand test accepts the original interface through the software copy/expansion path; GPU acceleration is unaccepted.
The 7E18 owner test accepts Power blank/wake. The earlier 4A102 fade measurement remains E20; system suspend is not inferred.
The Settings slider drives the panel; its minimum stays visible above the backlight's duty-cycle floor.
Human slide-to-unlock and touch are accepted in the 7E18 daily trial; the October 3 replay used synthetic contacts.
Two simultaneous contacts reach the app; pinch-to-zoom works in Photos.
Power blank/wake and complete Power-slider halt are owner accepted in 7E18; original HID delivery and selector buttons have separate records.
One M68 lock-screen TIFF saves and extracts to a pixel-identical PNG. A temporary pause was reported; capture latency and gallery visibility remain unmeasured.
One finite physical MPU6050 stream records 100 real samples. Callback rate is 6.80 Hz; calibrated stock rotation and client lifetime remain pending.
English UI is captured in QEMU and used in the daily profile. São Paulo time-zone installation/resolution passes; owner-visible clock acceptance remains pending.
Owner accepted the clean stock 7E18 upright preview. No 3.1.3 preview frame rate is measured; the two/six-slot 1.1.4 comparison is E59.
Stock 7E18 shutter, thumbnail and Photos pass the daily hand test. The same new image reopens after clean cold power-on.
The stock 1600 × 1200 output is resampled from real 640 × 480 acquisition; it adds no captured detail. Genuine higher-detail sensor modes remain pending.
The daily 7E18 owner test accepts battery level and charging indication; physical power-budget measurements remain the separate 4A102 record E31.
At the recorded 500 mA input limit, bright-lockscreen median battery balance was −55 mA; blanked idle was +166 mA. Heavy-use endurance is unproven.
System suspend is not implemented.
No dynamic frequency policy is accepted for the daily profile. The 7E18 timing baseline leaves the CPU clock unchanged.
Owner accepts Power-slider halt staying off for thirty seconds; native drain and PMIC request are separately traced.
One physical drained EL2→WDOG0 route reaches new SPL after 1.084 s and the ordinary selector. Repeated ordinary stock-restart hand acceptance is pending.
One paired physical replay reduces mean atomic traps by 98.50–99.91%. Mean frame gaps do not improve consistently; a UI speed multiplier is not established.
A later 64-presentation interval averages 12.7 ms elapsed work with zero sampled changes. This is not animation FPS or pure compositor CPU time.
One 4A102 physical queue comparison raises distinct selected images from 7.893 to 16.520/s. Unequal intervals and selection counters limit interpretation; this is not 7E18 throughput.
The audio codec path is not brought up.
No network interface is connected.
The board includes an EG25-G modem. Its native telephony service path is not integrated or accepted; No Service does not mean absent hardware.
Native MUSB reaches host enumeration and stock mux v2 handshake in finite physical trials; teardown, repeated replug and ordinary pairing are not accepted.
Later listener samples follow the host preflight; pairing, info, syslog and AFC remain pending at this committed snapshot.
The accepted compositor is stock software rendering. No native GPU/GLES driver or broad 3D-app coverage is established.
